mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY reg_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (title, amount, type, category, username, reg_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{category}, #{username}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total FROM transactions WHERE username = #{username} AND type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY category
